terra.problem: The notes do not mention friendships, and saying God’s law forbade them suggests that all friendships with foreigners were forbidden. The notes describe particular alliances, marriages, or worship practices instead.

The meaning does not mention that Clarke also offers a different possible interpretation involving children born outside marriage. He presents marriage or worship as another reading, not necessarily an agreement.
“Alliances” and “national deals” may be hard for a 10-year-old to understand.
